title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.47
body_markdown:
* **Added**: Slash commands for **Clear all context** and **Add all open files** in Ask mode
* **Added**: Drag and drop at the Folder level
* **Added**: Vision support in Agent mode
* **Added**: Support for MCP remote servers (SSE and Streamable HTTP types)
* **Added**: Log panel for MCP servers
* **Added**: Custom instructions in Edit mode
* **Changed**: Use inline diff view in Edit mode
* **Fixed**: Support for including unversioned files when generating Git commit messages
* **Fixed**: Improved support for UNC paths (e.g., WSL file paths) in Agent mode
* **Fixed**: Bugs affecting Copilot features in SQL Console
* **Fixed**: Various performance and reliability issues
